verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero illustration: the teal circle has dropped to the bottom-left while the orange can floats above it, only partly overlapping it, and the top-left is dead space. Its text column is also misaligned: the headline starts left of GLACIER, the body copy and the buttons, and the gap between the headline and the body is too large. B keeps the can and circle together as one unit, but its text block steps to the right line by line (the headline, badges and CTA each start further right). GLACIER floats on its own at top centre, leaving a large empty area top-right. B is less damaging because the product art stays intact.
